description: This file contains functions for CSV serialization and deserialization, including reading and writing CSV data, handling recordsets, and serialization logic specific to the ADODB PHP library.

methods.name: _rs2serialize
methods.description: Converts a recordset into a special serialized CSV format, including metadata and data rows.

methods.name: csv2rs
methods.description: Reads a CSV file or URL and converts it into a recordset object, handling different metadata formats and timeouts.

methods.name: adodb_write_file
methods.description: Writes contents to a file with file locking or atomic rename, handling Windows and other OS specifics.
